message.content:
Here’s a classic recipe for lasagna:

**Ingredients**

| Category | Item | Quantity |
|----------|------|----------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Fresh or dried lasagna noodles | 12–15 sheets (or one box of no-boil noodles) |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (450 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato passata | 28 oz (800 g) can |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | To taste |
| | Italian seasoning or oregano | 1 tsp |
| | Red wine (optional) | ½ cup |
| | Sugar (optional, to balance acidity) | 1 tsp |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp (60 g) |
| | All-purpose flour | 4 Tbsp (30 g) |
| | Milk | 4 cups (960 ml) |
| | Nutmeg, grated | Pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | To taste |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (beaten) | 1 |
| | Grated Parmesan | ¼ cup (25 g) |
| | Parsley, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | To taste |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups (200 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Optional: shredded provolone or fontina | ½ cup (50 g) |

Feel free to adjust quantities based on your serving size or personal preference!
